How the marketplace works

Parents use the app on a daily basis. Now they'll find you in it.

Every family at a Spare school uses the app to pay school fees, top up their child's wallet, and manage cafeteria orders. Your storefront sits right where their attention already is.

1

List your products or services

Add your catalogue to the Spare in-app marketplace — activity bookings, hotel stays, and more.

2

Target the right families

Reach specific grades, specific schools, or entire countries. Show your storefront only to the parents who are actually a fit.

3

Send newsletters and promotions

Use Spare's built-in newsletter and push notification tools to tell parents about new arrivals, seasonal offers, or events, directly inside the app they already trust.

Subject to each school's discretion.

4

Get paid on what you sell

Parents pay through the app, and that payment goes straight to you. Spare only takes a percentage when a sale happens. No listing fees, no monthly fees, no minimums.

Two ways to partner

Marketplace Partner

Sell directly to Spare families

List your products or services in the Spare marketplace and sell straight to parents at our partner schools.

Referral Partner

Introduce Spare, earn a commission

Know a school that belongs on Spare? Refer them and earn a commission when they come on board, no storefront required.

  • No products or inventory to manage
  • Earn a commission for every successful referral
  • Ideal for consultants, agencies, and well-connected networks
  • We handle the rest, onboarding, contracts, and support
